title: mcp.call/v1 request
description: Effect-only approved FlaUI call through change.propose/v1. First read mcp.tools/v1 Evidence. operation and target.locator = open_application, execute_step or cancel_step. One /call SET value = exact tool arguments; execute_step omits requestId (platform supplies original Effect UUID). precondition.revision = observed catalog_hash. verification = READ_BACK /call. Each call requires approval. Never retry actions with a new requestId on unknown results. Query original status only. COMPLETED confirms one operation, not test PASS. Artifact download paths are not saved project documents. execute_step also requires mcp.query inspect_window Evidence for the same appId and window; select controls from that observation. Desktop state can change; use a dedicated desktop and re-inspect after navigation.
